teaser.en: This giant forest vine climbs to the treetops and drops big orange fruits whose tangy pulp is sucked straight off the seeds.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa huu mkubwa wa msituni hupanda hadi vilele vya miti na kuangusha matunda makubwa ya rangi ya chungwa ambayo nyama yake chachu hufyonzwa moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye mbegu.
teaser.dg: Mmea hinyu mkulu wa tsaka unaokpwera unafika dzulu kabisa ya mihi, na matundage makulu ga rangi ya chungbwa ganagbwa photsi; atu nkufyondza nyama ya ngbwadu ya matunda higo kula kpwenye tembe.

summary.en: *Muungo* is a huge rubber vine of the coastal and riverine forests with large orange fruits. Its sour pulp is one of the wild fruits commonly eaten by the Digo, and its stems are woven into granaries.
summary.sw: *Muungo* ni mtambaa mkubwa sana wa mpira wa misitu ya pwani na ya kando ya mito, wenye matunda makubwa ya rangi ya chungwa. Nyama yake chachu ni mojawapo ya matunda ya porini yanayoliwa sana na Wadigo, na mashina yake husukwa kutengeneza vihenge.
summary.dg: *Muungo* ni mmea mkulu sana wa mpira wa matsaka ga pwani na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, wenye matunda makulu ga rangi ya chungbwa. Nyamaye ya ngbwadu ni kahi ya matunda ga tsaka ganayoriwa sana ni Adigo, na mihiye nkusukwa kuhenda vitsaga.

about.en:
*Muungo* is a massive liana that climbs right into the forest canopy. It has milky latex, large glossy leaves and fragrant white flowers.

The fruits are big, round and orange. Inside, the seeds are packed in a sweet-acid pulp that is pleasant to suck.
about.sw:
*Muungo* ni mtambaa mkubwa mno wenye shina gumu unaopanda hadi kileleni kabisa mwa msitu. Una utomvu kama maziwa, majani makubwa yanayong'aa na maua meupe yenye harufu nzuri.

Matunda ni makubwa, ya mviringo na ya rangi ya chungwa. Ndani, mbegu zimesongamana katika nyama tamu-chachu inayopendeza kufyonza.
about.dg:
*Muungo* ni mmea mkulu sana unaokpwera hadi dzulu kabisa ya matsaka. Una maziya, makodza makulu ganayong'ala na maruwa mereru genye arufu nono.

Matunda ni makulu, ga mviringo na ga rangi ya chungbwa. Ndani, tembe zinagbwirana kahi ya nyama ya mtswano na ngbwadu, nono kpwa kufyondza.

where.en: It grows in forest and thicket, especially riverine and coastal forest. Look up into the canopy near streams, or watch for the orange fruits on the forest floor.
where.sw: Hukua msituni na katika vichaka vizito, hasa misitu ya kando ya mito na ya pwani. Tazama juu kileleni mwa miti karibu na vijito, au angalia matunda ya rangi ya chungwa sakafuni mwa msitu.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka, hasa matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho na ga pwani. Lola dzulu kabisa ya mihi phephi na miho midide, au lola matunda ga rangi ya chungbwa photsi tsakani.

uses.en: The pulp is sucked off the seeds or used to make a sour juice, and it is listed among the wild fruits the Digo commonly eat. The tough stems are used to weave granaries, and the plant also gives a gum.
uses.sw: Nyama hufyonzwa kutoka kwenye mbegu au hutumika kutengeneza sharubati chachu, na imeorodheshwa miongoni mwa matunda ya porini ambayo Wadigo huyala mara kwa mara. Mashina magumu hutumika kusuka vihenge, na mmea pia hutoa gundi.
uses.dg: Nyama nkufyondzwa kula kpwenye tembe au nkuhumirwa kuhenda chinwadzi cha ngbwadu, na *muungo* unaandikpwa kahi ya matunda ga tsaka ganayoriwa sana ni Adigo. Mihiye migumu nkusukwa kuhenda vitsaga, na mmea piya unalavya gamu.

names.en: The Digo names are *muungo* and *mbungo*. Swahili uses *mbungo*, and *muungo* is also used in Pokomo. In English it is called a rubber vine. Swahili *mbungo* is also given for the related rubber vine *Landolphia kirkii*, so the names overlap.
names.sw: Majina ya Kidigo ni *muungo* na *mbungo*. Kiswahili hutumia *mbungo*, na *muungo* pia hutumika kwa Kipokomo. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *rubber vine*. *Mbungo* ya Kiswahili pia hutolewa kwa mtambaa mwingine wa mpira unaohusiana nao, *Landolphia kirkii*, kwa hivyo majina yanaingiliana.
names.dg: Madzina ga Chidigo ni *muungo* na *mbungo*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mbungo*, na *muungo* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa Chipokomo. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *rubber vine*. Kpwa Chiswahili *mbungo* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa *Landolphia kirkii*, mmea wanjina wa mpira ambao ni nduguye, kpwa hivyo madzina higa ganahumirwa kpwa mimea yosi miiri.

conservation.en: It has become much scarcer as its forest habitat has been cleared.
conservation.sw: Umepungua sana kadiri misitu unamoishi inavyofyekwa.
conservation.dg: Ukakala adimu sana kpwa sababu matsaka ganagokala makaloge gakatemwa.

reason.en: Related rubber vine with smaller orange fruits
reason.sw: Mtambaa wa mpira unaohusiana nao, wenye matunda madogo zaidi ya rangi ya chungwa
reason.dg: Nduguye, mmea wanjina wa mpira wenye matunda madide ga rangi ya chungbwa

reason.sw: Familia moja; tunda jingine la porini
reason.dg: Wa jamii mwenga; tunda ranjina ra tsaka

reason.en: Another sour fruit pulp made into drinks
reason.sw: Nyama nyingine ya tunda chachu inayotengenezwa vinywaji
reason.dg: Nyama yanjina ya tunda ra ngbwadu inayohendwa vinwadzi

reason.en: Another wild fruit of wet forest
reason.sw: Tunda jingine la porini la misitu yenye unyevu
reason.dg: Tunda ranjina ra tsaka ra matsaka genye madzi manji

definition.en: The sticky latex of this climber.
definition.dg: Utomvu unaonyata wa mmea hinyu unaokpwera.

use.en: Young people use it to make sticky traps for birds.
use.sw: Vijana huutumia kutengeneza mitego ya kunata ya kunasa ndege.
use.dg: Barobaro nkuuhumira kuhenda mihambo inayonyata ya kugbwira nyuni.
